text: Ko wano Men wahayinirnoo non e Annabaaɓe adinooɓe ma ɓen, Men wahayiniri Alqur'aana e maaɗa, an Nulaaɗo, e yamiroore Amen. A anndaano ko woni Defte jippiiɗe ɗen e ɓeya Nulaaɓe, a anndaano kadi ko woni gomɗinal; si ko woni, Men jippinin ndee Alqur'aanaare, ko nde ndayginnde, ndaygu ngu Men fewnirta mo Men muuyani e jeyaaɓe Amen ɓen. Pellet, ko a fewnoowo yimɓe ɓen, e laawol focciingol, woni diina lislaamu kan.
